lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered series of high-luminance, approximately circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows across the mid-section; cluster size and spacing diminish progressively towards the posterior regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal alignments of blobs, forming a rigid grid-like topology where blobs serve as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature traversing the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity values on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters localized primarily on the lower half of the visible first dorsal fin's surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-luminance linear abrasions and irregular patch-like markings are visible on the posterior flank and caudal peduncle area, distinct from the biological pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral region, appearing as dark, elongated silhouettes against the water column.
